qualification: Distinct source problem; full Lean proof of exact claimed outcome; complete written paper; independent review; reproducible verified artifact. Do not count supporting lemmas as separate outcomes.

verified.title: Diagonalizability conjecture for premagic matrices
verified.outcome: Refuted by a strictly positive 3x3 integer matrix, non-diagonalizable over R and C
verified.priority: new to project; worldwide priority not established

verified.title: Norm-one conjecture for dominant eigenvectors of non-negative premagic matrices
verified.outcome: Refuted as stated: the positive all-ones 2x2 matrix has dominant eigenvector (2,2), with squared Euclidean and Frobenius norms 8.
verified.priority: Elementary normalization correction; no worldwide novelty claim

verified.title: Eigenvalues of permutation-like matrices
verified.outcome: Every eigenvalue is zero or a root of unity; zero is an eigenvalue exactly for non-permutation matrices.
verified.priority: Complete permutation-like spectrum theorem; no worldwide priority claim.

verified.title: Fair-discrepancy propagation for fully balanced matrices
verified.outcome: Refuted for every positive tolerance by a strictly positive matrix with equal row and column squared energies.
verified.priority: No worldwide priority claim; fair-discrepancy is formal verification of Shivam Patel's posted counterexample.

verified.title: Scaled Tepper identity
verified.outcome: Scaled Tepper identity holds for all source parameters; see full formal statement.
verified.priority: Elementary source-corollary proof; no worldwide novelty claim

verified.title: Positive semidefiniteness of monochromatic-box matrices
verified.outcome: Positive semidefiniteness of monochromatic-box matrices holds for all source parameters; see full formal statement.
verified.priority: Known-result formal verification (resolved 2017)

verified.title: Nonzero spectrum of the one-shelf position matrix
verified.outcome: The displayed ceiling endpoint is false: for n=4 the predicted eigenvalue 1/16 does not occur.
verified.priority: Index-range correction to the stated conjecture; no worldwide-priority claim

verified.title: Four algebraic properties of signed-set fusion
verified.outcome: Four algebraic properties of signed-set fusion; exact scope in paper and formal theorem.
verified.priority: Four explicit algebraic assertions in the source signed-set model; no foundational set-theory claim

verified.title: A continuous nonlinear solution of the Matkowski equation
verified.outcome: A continuous nonlinear solution of the Matkowski equation; exact scope in paper and formal theorem.
verified.priority: Formal verification of a published counterexample (Kiss)

verified.title: Weight preservation for Fibonacci recurrences
verified.outcome: Normalized orbit weights are preserved under reduction for every positive divisor and every integer recurrence coefficient.
verified.priority: Formal verification of Shivam Patel’s posted orbit-counting proof; no worldwide novelty claim.

verified.title: Quadratic eigenvector of the one-shelf position matrix
verified.outcome: For every n>=3, the exact source quadratic is a nonzero eigenvector with eigenvalue 1/4; geometric multiplicity at least one.
verified.priority: Known mathematical result: special case of Tripathi, arXiv:2602.07920v1, Theorem I. New-to-this-package Lean verification; no priority claim.

verified.title: Graph-normalization adjacency inequality
verified.outcome: The full graph-normalization adjacency inequality holds, with no connectivity assumption needed.
verified.priority: Formal verification of a consequence of the standard diagonal majorization bound, also used in Guigues (2026), Appendix B; no worldwide priority claim.

verified.title: A positive recurrence for the Fill--Janson polynomial
verified.outcome: All coefficients are nonnegative for every natural exponent r, including the full bridge to the source formula.
verified.priority: Independent local formal verification of a known posted result; no new-discovery or first-formalization claim.

verified.title: Thirty-eight prime outputs refute the Ova counting bound
verified.outcome: The source construction has at least 38 distinct prime outputs for inputs 677 and 401; both bounds 10 and 13 are false.
verified.priority: Independent local formal verification of a known posted result; no new-discovery or first-formalization claim.

verified.title: Endpoint correction for positivity rigidity
verified.outcome: The printed rigidity statement is false because its conclusion constrains an endpoint coefficient absent from every hypothesis.
verified.priority: Literal source endpoint correction; no claim to refute the intended truncated-coefficient theorem or a new substantive open-problem resolution.

verified.title: Arithmetic-function simple ratio inequality
verified.outcome: The full source inequality holds for all n≥2 and k≥1, including actual totient, Dedekind psi and divisor-sum definitions.
verified.priority: Formal verification of Shivam Patel’s existing general proof; no first-proof or novelty claim.

verified.title: Arithmetic-function mixed ratio inequality
verified.outcome: The full source inequality holds for all n≥2 and k≥1, including actual totient, Dedekind psi and divisor-sum definitions.
verified.priority: Formal verification of Shivam Patel’s existing general proof; no first-proof or novelty claim.

verified.title: Inactive-coordinate rotations refute permutation rigidity
verified.outcome: A rational 1-by-3 rectangular example has a diagonal stationary expression and a genuinely nonpermutation orthogonal matrix.
verified.priority: A smaller explicit instance of the inactive-block mechanism already posted by Shivam Patel; full local Lean verification, no discovery or corrected-classification claim.

verified.title: Global convexity of the Bernstein basis square-sum
verified.outcome: The exact Bernstein basis square-sum is convex on the entire real line for every natural n; symmetry, monotonicity, and the sharp midpoint value are also proved.
verified.priority: Known convexity theorem (2014), independently formalized via finite Fourier averaging. Related327181/327182 are included as corollaries, not separate outcomes.

verified.title: A rational counterexample to both Schur stability assertions
verified.outcome: Both source Schur-stability assertions fail at the strictly admissible step t=1, with all hypotheses met and both spectral radii exactly one.
verified.priority: Formal verification of the s=1 specialization of Shivam Patel’s posted counterexample family; no discovery or priority claim.
